responsibility: Implements the low-level GENERIC construction utilities used throughout COBOL code generation. It creates and tracks the current translation unit and function state, defines shared builtin constants and type nodes, wraps GCC tree-building for expressions, calls, memory operations, control-flow scaffolding, variable/function declarations, inline assembler emission, and statement-list management, serving as the foundational tree-construction layer beneath genapi.cc.
same_name_distinction: Provides the implementations behind the gg_* GENERIC-building layer declared in gengen.h, including translation-unit/function state setup, builtin/tree node initialization, and concrete tree/call/storage construction routines.
